# Ontelivo

> Ontelivo is a one-person indie game studio. Its first game, Chess Abstract, is a free chess puzzle game for Android, available on Google Play.

## Chess Abstract
- [Game page](https://ontelivo.com/chess-abstract/): what the game is, how it plays, FAQ
- [Google Play listing](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ontelivo.chessabstract): download for Android
- [Support and FAQ](https://ontelivo.com/chess-abstract/support/): progress, privacy, contact
- [Privacy policy](https://ontelivo.com/chess-abstract/privacy/)
- [Terms of use](https://ontelivo.com/chess-abstract/terms/)

## Key facts
- Developer and publisher: Ontelivo (https://ontelivo.com/)
- Platform: Android (Google Play). Category: Puzzle
- The pieces keep their usual chess moves; every level is a short logic puzzle with its own goal; chapters are set in places around the world
- A daily puzzle, an endless mode, hints, and a guide to how every piece moves
- Free to download; contains optional rewarded ads (Google AdMob)
- No account; progress is stored on the player's phone
- Contact: support@ontelivo.com
